objective: Auditar exclusivamente en READ_ONLY la causa tecnica probable del rc=1 de Gate12I R2 despues de certificar rollback completo. Revisar contrato del runner, estructura de batches, compatibilidad SQL Server y el patron ALTER ADD columna seguido de FK/INDEX sobre la columna nueva en el mismo batch. Comparar con migraciones canonicas que usan sp_executesql para DDL dependiente. No ejecutar DDL, no modificar migracion, no tocar secrets ni Produccion.

queries.name: sql_engine_version
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS nvarchar(128)) AS product_version, CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('ProductLevel') AS nvarchar(128)) AS product_level, CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('Edition') AS nvarchar(128)) AS edition;

queries.name: database_compatibility
queries.sql: SELECT name, compatibility_level, is_read_committed_snapshot_on, snapshot_isolation_state_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE name=DB_NAME();

queries.name: target_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AS socios_object_id, OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona') AS persona_object_id, COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios',N'PersonaID') AS persona_col_length;

queries.name: permissions_sanity
queries.sql: SELECT HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios','OBJECT','ALTER') AS can_alter_socios, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona','OBJECT','REFERENCES') AS can_reference_persona, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','CREATE TABLE') AS can_create_table, IS_MEMBER('db_owner') AS is_db_owner, IS_MEMBER('db_ddladmin') AS is_db_ddladmin;
